data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'dominus', meaning 'lord' or 'ruler'. In Christian tradition, the name Dominik is associated with St. Dominic, founder of the Dominican Order. The name Dominik carries the meaning “Lord, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dominik usually hope their child will grow to embody lord, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dominik has its roots in the rich history of the Christian faith. It is derived from the Latin word 'dominus,' which means 'lord' or 'ruler'. This name bears the legacy of the powerful influence that Christianity had in Europe during the Middle Ages, where the title 'Dominus' was used to refer to the deity or a temporal ruler.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Dominik carries deep spiritual connotations. It is a name that invokes the spiritual power and authority of God, reminding the bearer of their ultimate allegiance and loyalty to Him as their Lord and Savior. Additionally, it honors St. Dominic, the founder of the Dominican Order, who instilled in his followers a commitment to studying and spreading the Gospel, thereby embodying the spiritual ideals of humility, prayer, and service to others.
